reason: ANAS-P learns per-layer convolution width masks during adversarial training/pruning and fine-tunes sparse ResNet/VGG models. Evaluation uses CIFAR-10/100 and TinyImageNet with TRADES/MART across sparsity levels, measuring clean and robust accuracy. It is CNN robustness, not transformer/LLM inference; shared pruning/FPGA lineage is too broad.
title: Neural architecture search for adversarial robustness via learnable pruning
